entries.title: Luke 22:1
segments: And the Feast of Unleavened Bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

entries.title: Luke 22:2
segments: And the chief priests and scribes sought how they might kill Him, for they feared the people.

entries.title: Luke 22:3
segments: And Satan entered into Judas, surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the Twelve.

entries.title: Luke 22:4
segments: And going, he talked with the chief priests and captains, how he might betray Him to them.

entries.title: Luke 22:5
segments: And they were glad and they agreed to give him silver.

entries.title: Luke 22:6
segments: And he fully consented, and he sought opportunity to betray Him to them, away from [the] crowd.

entries.title: Luke 22:7
segments: And the day of the Unleavened Bread came, when the passover must be killed.

entries.title: Luke 22:8
segments: And He sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the passover for us, so that we may eat.

entries.title: Luke 22:9
segments: And they said to Him. Where do You desire that we prepare?

entries.title: Luke 22:10
segments: And He said to them, Behold, when you have entered into the city, you will meet a man bearing a pitcher of water. Follow him into the house where he enters.

entries.title: Luke 22:11
segments: And you shall say to the master of the house, The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room where I shall eat the passover with My disciples?

entries.title: Luke 22:12
segments: And he shall show you a large, furnished upper room. Prepare there.

entries.title: Luke 22:13
segments: And they went and found it as He had said to them. And they prepared the passover.

entries.title: Luke 22:14
segments: And when the hour came, He and the twelve apostles with Him reclined.

entries.title: Luke 22:15
segments: And He said to them, With desire I have desired to eat this passover with you before I suffer.

entries.title: Luke 22:16
segments: For I say to you, I will not any more eat of it until it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God.

entries.title: Luke 22:17
segments: And He took the cup and gave thanks and said, Take this and divide [it] among yourselves.

entries.title: Luke 22:18
segments: For I say to you, I will not drink of the fruit of the vine until the kingdom of God shall come.

entries.title: Luke 22:19
segments: And He took bread and gave thanks, and He broke [it] and gave [it] to them, saying, This is My body which is given for you, this do in remembrance of Me.

entries.title: Luke 22:20
segments: In the same way also the cup, after having dined, saying, This cup [is] the new covenant in My blood, which is being poured out for you.

entries.title: Luke 22:21
segments: But, behold, the hand of My betrayer [is] with Me on the table.

entries.title: Luke 22:22
segments: And truly the Son of man goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man by whom He is betrayed!

entries.title: Luke 22:23
segments: And they began to inquire among themselves which of them it was that should do this thing.

entries.title: Luke 22:24
segments: And there was also a dispute among them as to which of them seems to be greater.

entries.title: Luke 22:25
segments: And He said to them, The kings of the nations exercise lordship over them. And they who exercise authority on them are called benefactors.

entries.title: Luke 22:26
segments: But you [shall] not [be] so: but the greater among you, let him be as the lesser, and he who governs, as [one] who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:27
segments: For which [is] the greater; he who reclines, or he who serves? [Is] it not he who reclines? But I am among you as He who serves.

entries.title: Luke 22:28
segments: You are those who have continued with Me in My trials.

entries.title: Luke 22:29
segments: And I appoint a kingdom to you, as My Father has appointed to Me,

entries.title: Luke 22:30
segments: that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom, and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

entries.title: Luke 22:31
segments: And the Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan has desired you, that he may sift [you] as wheat.

entries.title: Luke 22:32
segments: But I have prayed for you, that your faith fail not. And when you are converted, strengthen your brothers.

entries.title: Luke 22:33
segments: And he said to Him, Lord, I am ready to go with You, both into prison and into death.

entries.title: Luke 22:34
segments: And He said, I say to you, Peter, the cock shall not crow this day before you shall deny knowing Me three times.

entries.title: Luke 22:35
segments: And He said to them, When I sent you without purse and wallet and sandals, did you lack anything? And they said, Nothing.

entries.title: Luke 22:36
segments: And He said to them, But now, he who has a purse, let him take [it], and likewise [his] wallet. And he who has no sword, let him sell his garment and buy one.

entries.title: Luke 22:37
segments: For I say to you that this which is written must yet be accomplished in Me, "And he was reckoned among the transgressors"; for the things concerning Me have an end.

entries.title: Luke 22:38
segments: And they said, Lord, behold, here [are] two swords. And He said to them, It is enough.

entries.title: Luke 22:39
segments: And going out, according to [His] custom, He went to the Mount of Olives. And His disciples also followed Him.

entries.title: Luke 22:40
segments: And when He was at the place, He said to them, Pray that you do not enter into temptation.

entries.title: Luke 22:41
segments: And He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw. And He kneeled down and prayed,

entries.title: Luke 22:42
segments: saying, Father, if You are willing, remove this cup from Me. Yet not My will, but Yours be done.

entries.title: Luke 22:43
segments: And an angel appeared to Him from Heaven, strengthening Him.

entries.title: Luke 22:44
segments: And being in an agony He prayed more earnestly. And His sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

entries.title: Luke 22:45
segments: And when He rose up from prayer and had come to His disciples, He found them sleeping because of sorrow.

entries.title: Luke 22:46
segments: And [He] said to them, Why do you sleep? Rise and pray lest you enter into temptation.

entries.title: Luke 22:47
segments: And [as] He [was] yet speaking, behold a crowd! And he who was called Judas, one of the Twelve, went before them. And he drew near Jesus to kiss Him.

entries.title: Luke 22:48
segments: But Jesus said to him, Judas, do you betray the Son of man with a kiss?

entries.title: Luke 22:49
segments: And those around Him seeing what was about to occur, [they] said to him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

entries.title: Luke 22:50
segments: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest and cut off his right ear.

entries.title: Luke 22:51
segments: And Jesus answered and said, Let [it] go until now. And touching his ear, He healed him.

entries.title: Luke 22:52
segments: And Jesus said to the chief priests and commanders of the temple, and the elders, who had come to Him, Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and staves?

entries.title: Luke 22:53
segments: When I was with you in the temple daily, you did not stretch out your hand on Me. But this is your hour, and the authority of the darkness.

entries.title: Luke 22:54
segments: And laying hold on Him, they led [Him] away and brought Him into the high priest's house. And Peter followed afar off.

entries.title: Luke 22:55
segments: And lighting a fire in [the] middle of the court, and they sitting down, Peter sat in their midst.

entries.title: Luke 22:56
segments: But a certain slave-girl saw him as he sat by the fire and earnestly looked on him and said, This [man] was with him also.

entries.title: Luke 22:57
segments: And he denied Him, saying, Woman, I do not know Him.

entries.title: Luke 22:58
segments: And after a little while another saw him and said, You also are of them. And Peter said, Man, I am not!

entries.title: Luke 22:59
segments: And about an hour afterward, another confidently affirmed, saying, Truly this one was also with him, for he is a Galilean.

entries.title: Luke 22:60
segments: And Peter said, Man, I do not know what you say. And immediately, while he still spoke, the cock crowed.

entries.title: Luke 22:61
segments: And the Lord turned and looked on Peter. And Peter remembered the word of the Lord, how He had said to him, Before the cock crows, you shall deny Me three times.

entries.title: Luke 22:62
segments: And Peter went out and wept bitterly.

entries.title: Luke 22:63
segments: And the men who held Jesus mocked Him, beating [Him].

entries.title: Luke 22:64
segments: And blindfolding Him, [they] struck Him on His face. And they asked Him, saying, Prophesy! Who is it who struck you?

entries.title: Luke 22:65
segments: And they spoke many other things blasphemously against Him.

entries.title: Luke 22:66
segments: And when day came, the body of elders of the people, and the chief priests and the scribes, came together. And they led Him to the sanhedrin, saying,

entries.title: Luke 22:67
segments: Are you the Christ? Tell us. And He said to them, If I tell you, you will not believe.

entries.title: Luke 22:68
segments: Also if I ask [you], you will not answer Me nor let Me go.

entries.title: Luke 22:69
segments: From now on the Son of man shall sit at the right [hand] of the power of God.

entries.title: Luke 22:70
segments: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? And He said to them, You say [it], because I AM!

entries.title: Luke 22:71
segments: And they said, What need do we have for any witness? For we ourselves have heard it from his own mouth.
